summary: ADR-0059 accepted 2026-08-18; valid published/LKG catalog may replay frozen selection against current selected bytes and yield validator-owned successor context; knowledgeSelectionHash excludes source bytes; knowledgeContextHash binds selection/current source hashes/snapshot/Locator/decisions/predecessor; authority-envelope hash covers ADRs/rules/policies/contracts/registries/allowed successor kinds; stale freshness or query-quality may allow degraded execution only for unrelated targets with verifiable selection/authority/modules/read-set; publication failure neither advances current/LKG nor invalidates valid LKG consumption; selection/authority/contract/command-test/policy/protected-path/source-integrity/Knowledge self-change failures block or require semantic review; rapid-evolution permits same-selection degraded successor except Knowledge self-change, never publication/lifecycle/authority replacement; production-release requires current published Knowledge, publication-quality checks, applicable semantic review; extends ADR-0048/0050; supersedes only ADR-0057 stale-stop interpretation; publication query gate and LKG integrity remain strict
